```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(42)
```



```{r Filtering}

# Load sample-specific Seurat objects generated by the DoubletFinder step
srat_Epi1 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Epi1.rds")
srat_Epi2 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Epi2.rds")
srat_Epi3 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Epi3.rds")
srat_Epi4 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Epi4.rds")

srat_Control1 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Control1.rds")
srat_Control2 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Control2.rds")
srat_Control3 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Control3.rds")
srat_Control4 <- readRDS("../Doublets/srat_Control4.rds")


# DoubletFinder classification column names depend on the parameters selected for each sample. These correspond to the original analysis.
srat_Epi1$DoubletFinder <- srat_Epi1$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_50
srat_Epi2$DoubletFinder <- srat_Epi2$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_39
srat_Epi3$DoubletFinder <- srat_Epi3$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_115
srat_Epi4$DoubletFinder <- srat_Epi4$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_102

srat_Control1$DoubletFinder <- srat_Control1$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_94
srat_Control2$DoubletFinder <- srat_Control2$DF.classifications_0.25_0.01_486
srat_Control3$DoubletFinder <- srat_Control3$DF.classifications_0.25_0.02_100
srat_Control4$DoubletFinder <- srat_Control4$DF.classifications_0.25_0.005_112


# Keep singlets only
srat_Epi1 <- subset(srat_Epi1, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Epi2 <- subset(srat_Epi2, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Epi3 <- subset(srat_Epi3, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Epi4 <- subset(srat_Epi4, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")

srat_Control1 <- subset(srat_Control1, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Control2 <- subset(srat_Control2, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Control3 <- subset(srat_Control3, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")
srat_Control4 <- subset(srat_Control4, subset = DoubletFinder == "Singlet")


# Merge singlet-containing objects
KA_seurat_filtered <- merge(
  srat_Epi1,
  y = c(
    srat_Epi2,
    srat_Epi3,
    srat_Epi4,
    srat_Control1,
    srat_Control2,
    srat_Control3,
    srat_Control4
  ),
  project = "snIAKA_2026",
  merge.data = TRUE
)

# Join RNA layers after merging
KA_seurat_filtered[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(
  KA_seurat_filtered[["RNA"]]
)

# Save object for downstream annotation
saveRDS(
  KA_seurat_filtered,
  "KA_seurat_filtering.rds"
)

```
